agents.name: Scout
agents.role: Registers the GLEIF and SEC EDGAR records a supplier's identifiers name as Zetaris REST tables, then reads the ERP row and those records in one Zetaris query

agents.name: Resolver
agents.role: Finds the supplier's legal entity: the one its LEI names, or else the best match from a GLEIF search through Zetaris, scored with the Meterless World Model

agents.name: Judge
agents.role: Asks NVIDIA Nemotron through Meterless Nightshift which registry values state the ERP's facts, unless rules the Rule Smith promoted settle them

agents.name: Rule Smith
agents.role: Remembers the Judge's verdicts on the learning batch in Meterless H-MEM, dreams over them, and promotes the SQL rules Zetaris checks that the Judge confirmed every time; demotes a rule the Judge later overturns

agents.name: Decision
agents.role: Turns the verdicts into ready, fix or escalate under a fixed policy
